question: The International Date Line approximately follows which meridian?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**180°**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **International Date Line (IDL)** is an imaginary line of demarcation that runs through the **180° meridian**, except for some deviations to accommodate international borders and territorial waters.
 
• It serves as the boundary where the calendar date changes by exactly one day when crossed.
 
• The IDL is not straight; it zigzags to avoid dividing landmasses or countries into two different calendar dates.
 
• It is located on the opposite side of the Earth from the **Prime Meridian (0° longitude)**, which passes through **Greenwich, England**.
 
• When traveling east across the IDL, you subtract a day, and when traveling west, you add a day.
 
• The purpose of the IDL is to ensure a consistent global calendar system.
 
• The IDL runs mainly through the **Pacific Ocean**, avoiding disruption to populated areas.
 
• Countries near the IDL, such as **Kiribati and Samoa**, have adjusted their time zones for economic and administrative reasons, aligning with major trading partners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **90°E**__

 __
 
• This meridian is located in the **Eastern Hemisphere** and passes through countries such as **India, Bangladesh, and Myanmar**.
 
• It is not related to the International Date Line, as the IDL is located at **180° longitude**.
 
 
 
• **75°W**__
 __
 
• It lies in the **Western Hemisphere** and passes through countries like **Colombia, Venezuela, and the United States**.
 
• This meridian has no connection to the International Date Line.
 
 
 
• **0°**__
 
 
• The **Prime Meridian** is located at 0° longitude and passes through **Greenwich, England**.
 
• It is used as the reference point for measuring longitude and time zones, but it is not the International Date Line.
